messages:
sara: Incident: rerank evals showing an 8-12% drop in nDCG for model family 'redwood-v1-rerank' in eu-west1. Started ~07:02 UTC. Customer impact: ranking quality regressions for several hosted customers. Treating as SEV2.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created. Pager: oncall-mike. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-2026-042
mike: Oncall here — investigating now. Initial signal: eval harness and A/B comparisons point to a distribution shift in logits after the model weight refresh (deploy id: deploy-2026-04-11-07).
mike: Quick mitigation plan: rollback to pinned variant v1.2.3 for eu-west1. We'll do a staged rollback across clusters. ETA ~25-30m.
elaine: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and put a banner on status once we have ETA. Ping me when rollback starts.
ops: Rollback job started. Runbook command executed: `kubectl set image deploy/rerank rerank=redwood/v1.2.3 --record`
ops: rollback job id: rb-7782. Monitoring rollout.
mike: Root cause suspected: quantization artifact in v1.3.0-quant that compresses inter-example score separation. Repro steps + details in runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/rerank-quant-drift
oncall-bot: Alert update: p99-latency alert cleared, rerank-quality-alert still firing (nDCG delta ~ -9%).
mike: Partial rollback applied to eu-west1-a (30% traffic). Early eval shows nDCG gap reduced to -2%.
sara: Good progress. Please paste the current dashboard + logs links in-thread.
mike: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/rrRerank/rr-drift?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now
mike: Logs (deploy): https://logs.redwood.ai/q=deploy-2026-04-11-07
ops: Rollout to remaining eu-west1 clusters in progress. No elevated error rates observed. Dedicated customers with pinned routing are unaffected.
elaine: Status banner is live. Customer comms draft posted in #customer-success/drafts. @sara want to review before send?
sara: Reviewing now — hold external comms until metrics confirm baseline restored.
mike: Rollback completed in all eu-west1 clusters at 07:28 UTC. Final eval: nDCG within 0.5% of baseline across the standard eval set.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 -> RESOLVED. Duration: 26m. Postmortem owner: @mike. Postmortem link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042
ops: Artifacts archived: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/INC-2026-042 (logs, eval snapshots, deploy diffs).
elaine: Sending customer notifications now. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :tada:
